lines.en: Han Sooyoung had once told me.
―There's a clone I made the first time I used [Avatar]······ Maybe I gave it too many memories, because it suddenly became uncontrollable and I couldn't retrieve it.
“……Interesting. Where did you hear that?”
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ is curious about you.]
[Your understanding of the character ‘Han Sooyoung’ is increasing!]
Han Sooyoung's clone looked at me with apparent interest.
Her eyes were so full of life that, for a moment, I doubted whether she really was a clone. Even the actual Han Sooyoung wouldn't have been so unruffled.
“I'm acquainted with your original. She's a bit loose-lipped.”
“Hmm…… A childish provocation, but I'll let it slide this once. You're wrong. I'm not Han Sooyoung's ‘clone.’ I'm the real Han Sooyoung herself.”
“What?”
The shape of her mouth as she smiled was unmistakably Han Sooyoung's.
“I have memories she doesn't.”
“Memories? What memories?”
“And unlike her, I know how to keep my mouth shut.”
I gripped the hilt at my waist.
“I've heard clones can survive even after their heads are cut off.”
Now that I'd come this far, I had no intention of dragging things out either.
‘Unbreakable Faith’ let out a harsh cry in my right hand.
[The demon king ‘Demon King of Salvation’ looks at the incarnation ‘Han Sooyoung.’]
The Narrative-grade ‘Status’ I released sent a heavy shudder through the entire suite.
A commotion rose from below, but Han Sooyoung didn't seem nervous at all.
“……A demon king. You're a bigger deal than I thought.”
And the next moment, I understood why she was so at ease.
Bzzzzzt!
A net of probability cast over the entire room.
The Status I had released rapidly subsided.
[This area is a ‘Temporary Nonaggression Zone.’]
[Combat in this area is prohibited for the next hour.]
She'd designated it a ‘Temporary Nonaggression Zone’……
“……Did you make a deal with a dokkaebi?”
“Someone who can control Yoo Joonghyuk showed up. This is the least I could do.”
I decided to stop thinking of the person before me as a mere ‘clone.’
Perhaps, as she claimed, this really was the true ‘Han Sooyoung.’
At that very moment, a system message sounded.
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ has activated ‘Eyes of Truth’!]
Eyes of Truth.
At least when it came to ‘Detect Attributes,’ it was a skill comparable to Anna Croft's ‘Great Demon's Eyes.’
In that brief interval, Han Sooyoung had tried to read my information.
[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ activates!]
[‘Fourth Wall’ completely counters ‘Eyes of Truth’……]
As sparks flew, Han Sooyoung hastily canceled her skill.
“……That's one hell of a skill you have.”
Han Sooyoung didn't push her luck. She neither tried to force her way through [Fourth Wall] like Yoo Joonghyuk nor looked flustered like Anna Croft.
Even that composure was something the Han Sooyoung I knew didn't have.
Han Sooyoung smiled as though she were truly enjoying herself.
“You can cut my head off later. How about a game? Ever heard of ‘Sacred Three-Question Exchange’?”
It was the exchange of questions and answers I had once undertaken with Olympus's ‘Ariadne.’
“We both have things we want to know about each other, right? Let's trade, one at a time.”
I couldn't tell what she was scheming.
But it was clear that this could be an opportunity for me as well.
I nodded and said,
“All right.”
“But let's add a rule. We're allowed to ‘lie.’”
“……Then what's the point of the ‘Three-Question Exchange’?”
“It's fun.”
Han Sooyoung's catlike eyes curved gently.
It wasn't hard to read what she was thinking.
I grinned and answered.
“Sure. All right.”
With my answer, messages appeared in the air.
―The Sacred Three-Question Exchange (三問答) begins.
―Both parties may exchange three questions and answers.
―Each party may refuse to answer once.
―The exchange will not end until all questions and answers have been fully exchanged.
“I'll go first.”
―You are using your first question.
“Tell me the terms of the ‘Otherworld Pledge’ you made with ‘Secretive Plotter.’”
At my first question, Han Sooyoung's gaze wavered slightly.
[Your understanding of the character ‘Han Sooyoung’ has increased!]
The key to this exchange was to devise ‘specific questions’ that would be difficult for the other person to evade. And to make the most of whatever information you could guess at.
Han Sooyoung spoke as though sulking.
“You knew that much? This won't be easy.”
“Just answer the question.”
“Which means you've made an ‘Otherworld Pledge’ too.”
She was quick on the uptake, all right.
In that respect, she was like the third-round Han Sooyoung.
Han Sooyoung continued.
“I made a contract with ‘Secretive Plotter’ for the completion of ‘a certain world.’ If I did what the Plotter wanted, the Plotter would help me complete the world I wanted.”
―You have received your first answer.
It wasn't straightforward, but the answer wasn't entirely uninformative either.
What mattered was whether it was true.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Lie Detection Lv.6’!]
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ has activated ‘Poker Face Lv.10’!]
[‘Lie Detection’ is nullified by the effects of ‘Poker Face’!]
As expected. I knew she'd use that skill.
Poker Face had been among the skills I'd checked through ‘Character List.’
As long as she had that skill, it was impossible to determine the truth of her answers through ‘Lie Detection.’
Of course, that didn't mean I had no solution.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’!]
[Your understanding of this person is sufficient. Activating ‘Stage 2’ of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint!]
Now that she had become a ‘character,’ simply asking a question would let me read her thoughts. But the next moment.
「I knew it」
「I told you」
「Ack, don't step on my foot!」
「What are you peeking at?」
Hundreds of voices flooded in at once, bringing a pain that felt as though my head would burst. Before I could even cry out in shock, I had to hastily cancel the skill.
[‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’ is deactivated!]
I stared blankly at Han Sooyoung. She was wearing her signature smile.
“I had my suspicions, and there we go. I figured you'd have a skill like that.”
“……What was that just now?”
“Can I count that as your second question?”
I reflexively shut my mouth.
Han Sooyoung smiled mischievously.
“Well, I'll give you this one for free. It's an application of the ‘Avatar’ skill.”
Only then did I think I understood what had happened.
Han Sooyoung had just used her ‘clones’ to split her own consciousness into hundreds of pieces.
Looking at Han Sooyoung's triumphant expression, I felt my heart race for the first time in a while.
I had never faced an opponent like this before.
Han Sooyoung spoke.
“My turn to ask.”
―The incarnation ‘Han Sooyoung’ is using her first question.
“You've written a novel called ‘Ways of Survival,’ haven't you?”
Some questions contained information in the questions themselves.
Now I knew exactly what she thought of me.
Time to put my specialty to use.
“That's right. I wrote it.”
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ uses ‘Lie Detection Lv.10’!]
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Poker Face Lv.5’!]
Sorry, but I had ‘Poker Face’ too.
Just before coming to this round, I'd bought a whole bunch of skills I needed from the [Dokkaebi Bag].
[‘Lie Detection’ is nullified by the effects of ‘Poker Face’!]
At that message, the corners of Han Sooyoung's mouth lifted faintly.
“You're really entertaining.”
I was finding her just as entertaining.
“……Is this really Yoo Joonghyuk?”

Lee Seolhwa asked, touching her lips as though she couldn't believe it. Before her stood the man she had only heard about: ‘Iron Blood Supreme King Yoo Joonghyuk.’ Standing like a life-size cutout, Yoo Joonghyuk stared blankly into space, barely acknowledging her.
In that short time, a crowd had gathered around Yoo Joonghyuk. Lee Jihye was the first to scold them.
“What, is this a sightseeing tour? You've all seen him on-screen plenty of times. What's with you?”
“It's fascinating, that's all…… We've never seen him stand this still. How did he do it? Did he use poison?”
Even Han Donghoon, seated in the situation room, had opened a panel to observe Yoo Joonghyuk. Kim Namwoon sidled over and stood beside Yoo Joonghyuk, striking an odd pose.
Click. Click.
Watching him, Lee Jihye frowned.
“……What are you doing?”
Startled, Kim Namwoon floated his phone into the air, as though there was no helping it now that he'd been caught. A hand reached out of his shadow and took hold of the smartphone for him.
“Hey, get in the picture too. You don't get many chances like this.”
“What the—let go! Why are you taking pictures?”
Lee Jihye growled as he grabbed her wrist.
The photo was taken with a click. It captured an expressionless Yoo Joonghyuk, a snickering Kim Namwoon, and a fuming Lee Jihye.
“Hey, soldier! Don't just stand there beside us. Move! We're taking pictures!”
When Kim Namwoon snapped at Lee Hyunsung, who had been standing there blankly, Lee Seolhwa walked over and rapped Kim Namwoon on the head.
“Namwoon, didn't I tell you to speak respectfully to Hyunsung-ssi?”
“Ugh, no! Stop nagging me!”
Click.
“But are you sure this man is safe?”
“Want me to give him a stab?”
“Don't pull that shit. The guy who went upstairs set some weird trigger before he left. One wrong move and we're all dead.”
Click.
“A trigger? What trigger?”
“I think he ordered him to go berserk if anyone harms him.”
“Hmm, harms him…… Then how about this?”
Grinning, Kim Namwoon plopped a hand on Yoo Joonghyuk's shoulder.
Yoo Joonghyuk showed no reaction.
“Huh, so this much is okay? Then what about this?”
Surrounding the empty Yoo Joonghyuk, the others laughed and chattered. Some were fascinated; others were having fun.
Click.

In the photos being taken one after another, Yoo Joonghyuk's expression was changing little by little. A very faint emotion stirring deep within his empty eyes. Perhaps it was an emotion even Yoo Joonghyuk himself could not understand. A feeling as though his eyes were growing hot, as though something was tightening around his heart. But Yoo Joonghyuk wasn't fully conscious and had no way of knowing what that emotion was.
“Huh? What was that? I think he just moved.”
“……Are you sure you didn't imagine it?”
“No! He really……”
All he knew were the words Kim Dokja had left him.
Recall happy memories.
―Warning! Warning! The ‘Archangel of Hellfire’ is approaching!
At the warning that sounded from thin air, the companions clustered around Yoo Joonghyuk looked up in alarm. Kim Namwoon was the first to shout.
“What? Fuck! Why is that crazy bitch coming here?”
“We're screwed. Everyone, get ready. Hyunsung ajusshi, hurry upstairs and tell Master!”
As the others scattered, Yoo Joonghyuk remained where he was. A few people knocked against him as they hurried past, as though he were in the way.
Recall happy memories.

Amid the rapidly unfolding situation, Yoo Joonghyuk watched the enormous panel that had appeared in the air. On it, a dazzling angel moved amid crimson flames, an eerie light blazing in her eyes. Each time the angel's burning sword moved, the surrounding ruins were engulfed in a sea of fire.
Yoo Joonghyuk tilted his head.
Within his empty memories, Yoo Joonghyuk had seen that angel before.
Happy memories.
Strangely, those memories felt both unfamiliar and welcome.
Distant, cold memories, as though a thick wall stood between him and them.
In those memories, she was a little doll.
―The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ grins.
―The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ hopes you will not cause unnecessary sacrifices.
Those were not his memories.
They were merely records left on someone else's wall, and he had merely peeked at them. Those memories belonged to a world that did not exist for him. They were fiction (虛構).
―The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your camaraderie.
And yet Yoo Joonghyuk could not understand why he remembered that fiction so vividly.
―The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ rubs her cheek against you.
The burning archangel was looking at him from within the screen.
Like a child who had only just learned to speak, Yoo Joonghyuk murmured.
“……Uriel.”
About twenty minutes had passed since my conversation with Han Sooyoung began.
Through the Three-Question Exchange, I had been able to infer a few things.
One, the 1863rd round's ‘Han Sooyoung’ had made a contract with Secretive Plotter through an ‘Otherworld Pledge.’
Two, the 1863rd round's ‘Han Sooyoung’ might not be a clone of the third-round Han Sooyoung.
Three, the 1863rd round's ‘Han Sooyoung’ had more information than the third-round Han Sooyoung (and was a little smarter).
Putting those together, I could infer a few more things.
For instance, this Han Sooyoung had most likely come here from the same ‘third round’ as me. And she was making calculations about the future using some method I didn't know……
I said to Han Sooyoung,
“Thanks to you, I've learned some useful things. All that's left now is my final question, right?”
“Hmm, can't I skip answering that one? I've learned enough about you now.”
“……Really? What have you learned?”
“Is that your third question?”
“No.”
Han Sooyoung smacked her lips and smiled.
“Kim Dokja from the third round. What was the ‘me’ there like?”
Just as I was about to tell her she'd used up her questions, a chill ran through me.
……How did she know I'd come from the third round?
“Oh, judging by your face, I got it right? It was a guess.”
“Don't lie. You knew when you said it.”
“Ahaha, you didn't fall for it.”
Our gazes met in midair.
Han Sooyoung moistened her lower lip and asked,
“The third-round me…… Doesn't she have a few screws loose? I took too many of her memories, you see.”
“She's doing fine in her own way. Why don't you worry about yourself?”
“Are you sticking up for her? Then why didn't you share some information with her? You read the whole novel. You could afford that much generosity, couldn't you?”
“……I don't know what you're talking about.”
“I was really curious what kind of person would read a novel like that to the end. You've exceeded my expectations, Kim Dokja.”
The third-round Han Sooyoung was no pushover, but this one was something else entirely.
“I believe I told you I was the author.”
Han Sooyoung burst out laughing.
“You're not the author. You're too smart to have written that novel. Though you're too stupid to fool me.”
“Just because of that……”
“And I have an idea what sort of being the author of ‘Ways of Survival’ is.”
I almost asked who that ‘author’ was.
But when I didn't know whether this was a trap, I couldn't rashly expose a weakness.
Frowning, I asked a different question.
“If you thought I wasn't the author, why ask that question in the first place?”
“Who knows? Why did I?”
Han Sooyoung still wore her relaxed smile.
It wasn't hard to guess.
Han Sooyoung had asked whether I'd ever written Ways of Survival.
And by answering, I'd effectively admitted that I knew ‘Ways of Survival’…… Damn it.
I decided to cut the conversation short here and ask the most important question.
“I'll ask my final question.”
―You are using your third question.
“How did you survive all the way to scenario 95? You couldn't have read past chapter 99 of ‘Ways of Survival’—”
That was when a deafening crash came from downstairs.
As an alarm sounded, Lee Hyunsung came scrambling up the emergency stairs into the suite and shouted.
“Captain! We have a serious problem!”
At the same time as Lee Hyunsung's shout, the two angels tucked against my chest sent out indirect messages.
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ is appalled by something!]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ warns you!]
An unusual glint crossed Han Sooyoung's eyes.
“Those flowers of yours……”
I ignored her and rushed to the exterior window.
I didn't know exactly what had happened.
But if I was right……
Roooooar!
The shadow of a gigantic dragon rose into the air outside the window.
For a moment, I wondered if someone had awakened the Apocalypse Dragon, but that couldn't be.
I caught my breath at the sight of the enormous dragon beating its wings in the sky.
Right. I'd been wondering why I hadn't seen her.
“Everyone, get out of the way! I can't handle this alone!”
A woman wrapped in a pure white fur coat was commanding the enormous dragon there.
Beast Lord Shin Yoosung.

With every trace of childhood now gone, she was protecting the companions in scenario 95. The ‘Chimera Dragon,’ which had evolved beyond a grade 1 monster into a special-grade monster, unleashed a tremendous breath.
Whoooooosh!
But even its breath could not extinguish the oncoming flames.
Instead, the flames burned all the more fiercely, feeding on the poison.
I knew those flames.
The fire that burned in the lowest depths of <Eden>: Hell Flames Ignition (地獄炎火).
I knew Han Sooyoung's intervention had changed the future.
But this 1863rd round also had things in common with the 1863rd round I knew.
For instance, the name of the last surviving archangel in this fallen world.
“Uriel.”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is enraged!]
An explosive gust shattered the building's exterior windows. Shin Yoosung's Chimera Dragon was plummeting.
I vaulted through the window and leaped into the wind.
Shin Yoosung fell limply into my arms.
Startled, Shin Yoosung looked up at me.
“Who……”
“Let me take a moment to stop the bleeding.”

I activated [Pressure Point] and pressed points on Shin Yoosung's neck and arms where her Story was leaking out. Just then, something stirred within me, and transparent strings of text appeared at my fingertips.
「‘Fourth Wall’ wears a mischievous expression.」
I realized what it was about to do.
‘Don't.’
「‘Fourth Wall’ says with a crestfallen expression, ‘Tch.’」
I didn't want the people of this world to know the story of my round.
Though it angered me, though it felt unfair.
I still thought some things couldn't be helped.
Tap.
I landed lightly and set Shin Yoosung down on the ground.
A little later, Lee Hyunsung landed with Han Sooyoung on his shoulders. Shin Yoosung staggered to her feet and spoke to Han Sooyoung.
“……Captain, I'm sorry.”
“It's okay.”
Han Sooyoung jumped down from Lee Hyunsung's shoulders, gave Shin Yoosung a pat on the shoulder, and stepped forward. Watching that scene left me with a very strange feeling.
Yoo Joonghyuk was the one who should have been standing there.
“Coat.”
Han Sooyoung held out a hand. Lee Jihye ran over and handed her the white coat she'd taken from Kim Namwoon.
“Here, Master.”
With a swish, the coat swept around Han Sooyoung and shrank to fit her frame.
Maybe it was just my imagination, but it looked cooler than mine.
Han Sooyoung turned up her collar and looked toward Gwanghwamun.
A hellscape blazing amid thick dust.
Constellations burning in hellfire screamed helplessly.
One by one, the remnants of stars crumbled into ash.
This was the scene of the descent of Uriel, the Evil-Destroying Archangel.
Watching the flames beyond the billowing dust, I asked Han Sooyoung,
“……Don't tell me Uriel came here for the reason I'm thinking of?”
“What reason are you thinking of?”
“The fall of <Eden>.”
“Then I guess you're right.”
At our exchange, the flowers against my chest trembled.
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ asks what that means!]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ glares at you.]
Of course the archangels wouldn't know.
What had become of <Eden> in the 1863rd round.
Honestly, I had hoped they would never find out.
Amid the white flames surging across Gwanghwamun, strange creatures approached from all directions.
Nameless Ones.
Drawn to Uriel's Status like moths to a flame, they were gathering here one by one. I asked Han Sooyoung,
“Do you need help?”
“I'd appreciate it. The Archangel of Hellfire is a tricky opponent, after all.”
Yoo Joonghyuk was looking at me, waiting for my command.
Han Sooyoung continued.
“At this rate, someone might die.”
I bit my lip.
This round was not my round.
And Yoo Joonghyuk had no companions in this round.
“Yoo Joonghyuk. Stop Uriel.”
At my words, Yoo Joonghyuk moved.
I truly hadn't wanted to do this.
Spotting Yoo Joonghyuk, Uriel lost all reason and screamed.
Aaaaaaah!
She could hardly react any other way.
One of the reasons this round's <Eden> had been doomed to fall was right before her eyes.

The furious Uriel's [Hell Flames Ignition] formed a wave, and Yoo Joonghyuk's [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] scattered rays of light as it cut through it. The collision of their terrifying Status sent tremendous shock waves through the sky.
The third-round Yoo Joonghyuk and Uriel would never believe it if they saw this.
I didn't want to see it either.
I had hoped this sight would remain only in my head forever.
The flowers against my chest trembled harder.
Finally unable to bear it any longer, Gabriel spoke in her True Voice.
[Why is Uriel attacking him? You know something, don't you? Don't you?]
I nodded.
[Tell me now! If you don't—]
“What good would telling you do?”
There was nothing we could change.
No, perhaps we shouldn't change it.
This fight had arisen from the chain of cause and effect in the 1863rd round.
Uriel's anger was justified, and Yoo Joonghyuk deserved to bear it.
I watched with my fists clenched hard enough to crush them. Beside me, Han Sooyoung spoke in an admiring tone.
“……So you really can control Yoo Joonghyuk. Honestly, I didn't believe it.”
“Can you stop the rest?”
“No problem. Oh, and I think I'll repay you for helping.”
Han Sooyoung continued.
“You asked me earlier, didn't you? How I managed to survive all the way to this scenario……”
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ tells the Story ‘Predictive Plagiarism (豫想剽竊).’]
“Here's your answer.”
White light was seeping from Han Sooyoung's body. Her eyes shone pure white as they read the patterns of the approaching monsters.
……Future Sight?
There was no mistaking it. I didn't know how it worked, but it was unquestionably an ability similar to Future Sight. And one that hadn't existed in the original novel.
「There is nothing new under the sun. All that will be written is a variation of what has already been written.」
I could hear every word of the Story flowing from Han Sooyoung.
She activated ‘Unbreakable Faith,’ effortlessly lopped off the approaching monsters' heads, and smiled.
“I'm a first-rate writer. And ‘Ways of Survival’ is, at best, a collection of clichés. What's so hard about predicting the plot? In the end, it's just the same patterns repeating.”
As if to prove her point, Han Sooyoung deftly read the approaching monsters' patterns and continued to hunt them down. I watched for a moment, then spoke through gritted teeth.
“You're saying that alone kept you alive?”
I could certainly admit it was an impressive ability.
“Ways of Survival is a story packed with complex worldbuilding. Writer or not, there are things you can do and things you can't.”
“Yes, you're right.”
The next moment, white light burst from Han Sooyoung's body, and countless clones sprang out. Ten, twenty, thirty…… In an instant, they numbered over a hundred, each holding ‘Unbreakable Faith.’
“That would be true if there were only one of me.”

Han Sooyoung swung the sword in her hand, and hundreds of Han Sooyoungs rushed onto the battlefield at once. Unafraid of death, they calmly cut down the ‘Nameless Ones.’ Han Sooyoung kept multiplying.
“But what if that one person became two, then three?”
What one person could do differed from what a hundred could do.
And what a hundred could do differed from what a thousand could do.
“Did you know? Ten thousand people can accomplish in two days what one person could do over an entire lifetime.”
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’!]
So many voices flooded in at once that I was nearly overwhelmed.
Those voices soon formed a single image.
I realized it was the landscape inside Han Sooyoung's mind.
Countless Han Sooyoungs were putting their heads together there, envisioning a world.
「This is wrong.」
「This is what happens next. That one's definitely going to show up.」
「No, this is right. The archangel Uriel……」
「Let's take a majority vote.」
Simulations of the world envisioned by countless Han Sooyoungs.
Perhaps Yoo Joonghyuk was not the only regressor.
Inside someone's mind, millions of worlds were ceaselessly born and destroyed.
Because of one tiny mistake.
Or because of one tiny flaw.
The sight of a story being built, layer upon layer, in pursuit of utter flawlessness.
For a moment, I was drawn into the story Han Sooyoung was envisioning.
Because the birth and destruction (生滅) of those stories were so heartbreaking, and so beautiful.
Some developments I could agree with.
Others were developments even I had never imagined.
I didn't want to admit it, but I had no choice.
Some copies (複製) surpass the original.
An effort made solely to create a perfect ‘single course of events.’
And this world was the result of what that Han Sooyoung had planned.
I raised my head and looked at Yoo Joonghyuk. Yoo Joonghyuk, swinging his sword impassively even as his shirt tore and blood splashed across his skin. And Uriel, fighting against him.
Where no companion died.
Where no destruction ever came.
A world where everyone could join forces and reach the ‘final scenario.’
Damn it, I had no choice but to agree.
And for this world to be completed, Yoo Joonghyuk……
Han Sooyoung looked at me.
Her eyes seemed to say she already understood what I was thinking.
“You must have realized by now too. This world doesn't need him.”
The plagiarist who dreamed of a world surpassing the original spoke to me.
“I know how to kill Yoo Joonghyuk.”
She knew how to kill Yoo Joonghyuk.
That was what Han Sooyoung had just said.
I hesitated, then spoke.
“……You shouldn't have to do that. A perfect story isn't the best story.”
In the distance, Yoo Joonghyuk and Uriel collided with a deafening crash.
The light exploding in the sky washed Han Sooyoung's eyes white.
“Yoo Joonghyuk has to die in this scenario. That's how the world I've wanted will be completed.”
“What kind of world do you even want……”
“You looked inside my head, didn't you? And you're still asking that?”
Another deafening crash drowned out my voice.
It had been a meaningless question to begin with.
As Han Sooyoung had said, I'd caught a glimpse of the world she dreamed of.
A utopia without a single flaw.
An answer only someone who had absorbed the original novel in a completely different way from me could give.
I turned to watch Uriel and Yoo Joonghyuk fight.
In the world Han Sooyoung dreamed of, the answer to this battle was as follows.
「Here, the Archangel of Hellfire dies.」

As if they had been waiting for this, the companions were gathering around the site of Uriel and Yoo Joonghyuk's fierce battle. Lee Jihye was preparing Instant Kill; Lee Hyunsung was charging Great Mountain Smash. I also saw Kim Namwoon unwinding his bandages as though he meant to summon the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.’
I took ‘Unbreakable Faith’ in hand.
Noticing my movement, Han Sooyoung glared at me.
“Wait, you……!”
It was certainly Han Sooyoung who had created this world, not me or Yoo Joonghyuk.
But…… so what?
[The demon king ‘Demon King of Salvation’ unleashes his ‘Status.’]
This wasn't the kind of story I wanted to read in the first place.
Cr-r-rack.

Small horns rose from my head, symbolizing the Status of a demon king. I wanted to manifest wings as well, but the incomplete ‘Demon Realm's Spring’ couldn't muster that much Status. Han Sooyoung seemed surprised, but she didn't stop me. She probably thought it was impossible for me to stop that fight with my strength alone.
I knew that too.
But right now, I wasn't alone.
“Gabriel. Jophiel.”
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ looks at you.]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ looks at you.]
“Please help me.”
[The archangel says this manifestation will require more probability than before.]
“It doesn't matter.”
Bzzzzzzzt!
The instant I gave permission, the two angels' Status settled behind me. Pain struck as though my shoulder blades were breaking, and I felt something grow through my skin, tearing it open.
[An archangel's ‘Status’ is with you.]
Six wings growing through my shoulders, just as when I'd defeated the constellations.
Whoooooosh!
[The demon king's ‘Status’ and the archangel's ‘Status’ are clashing within you.]
Incompatible Stories screamed within me, unable to blend.
An archangel's Status overlaid upon a demon king's power.
Waves of Status that defied all common sense swept across the battlefield.
“What is that Status……!”
Of course they would be shocked.
Uriel was the only archangel still alive in this world.
Yet the ‘Status’ emanating from me was unmistakably an archangel's.
[The demon king ‘Black Mane Lion’ shows malice at the sight of you!]
[The demon king ‘Devil of Lust and Wrath’ takes notice of you!]

A demon king's and an archangel's Status dwelled within a single being. It was no wonder they were shocked. As far as I knew, only one being in the world of ‘Ways of Survival’ had ever been capable of producing such a Status.
[Demon. King……!]
Sensing my presence, Uriel turned toward me.
Just as I was about to speak to her, Gabriel, who had descended into me, beat me to it.
[Uriel! Stop! What in the world are you doing!]
At the archangel's majestic True Voice, a flicker of reason briefly returned to Uriel's eyes, which had been blazing with rage.
[……Gabriel?]
[Have you come to your senses? What is this? Why on earth are you acting like this!]
Brightening, Gabriel continued speaking through me in her True Voice.
As I watched Uriel's eyes turn cold, I realized my mistake too late.
[Look, it's the ones you liked! Yoo Joonghyuk and Kim Dokja! You used to talk my ear off about them!]
Just as Gabriel's manifested Status began to approach Uriel, Uriel's lips parted.
[What are you babbling about, you ■■■?]
Bewildered, Gabriel's body froze in midair.
Uriel continued.
[So you were alive, Gabriel. And clinging to a demon king, no less.]
[Wh-what are you talking about?]
Aaaaaaah!
Uriel's rampaging magic summoned a storm across Gwanghwamun. [Hell Flames Ignition] ran wild, turning the entire area into a hellscape. I saw Yoo Joonghyuk's coat melting in the searing heat.
Grrrrraaaaah!
Caught in the blast, the ‘Nameless Ones’ scattered as chunks of flesh.
I gritted my teeth and shouted.
“Gabriel!”
Belatedly, the stunned Gabriel returned control of her power to me.
[……You will explain this to me later.]
Honestly, I wasn't confident I could.

I couldn't simply recite the entire history of what had taken place in <Eden> in the 1863rd round. I had no idea what repercussions would follow if an archangel from the third round learned that information. More than that, I couldn't imagine the emotional shock Gabriel would suffer.
Because…… the Gabriel of the 1863rd round had betrayed <Eden>.
“Yoo Joonghyuk!”
The moment I kicked off the ground, Yoo Joonghyuk cut through the incoming hellfire with [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship]. I leaped into the gap between the flames.
Bzzzzzt!

Three petals each from Gabriel and Jophiel fluttered into the air from inside my clothes. As an enormous amount of Status built up, something surged up inside me. Using the recoil of the clashing magic, I closed the distance to Uriel in a single burst.
I'm sorry, Uriel.

I seized Uriel's head with both hands. The magic of White Pure Star Energy, imbued with both an archangel's and a demon king's Status, blasted into her skull. Uriel grimaced as though in pain, but showed no sign of being cowed.
Instead, her flames were slowly consuming me.
In the inconceivable heat, the bases of my wings and my horns were melting little by little. I was the first to groan.
This was the power of Eden's strongest battle angel.
With a cruel smile, Uriel summoned [Flames of Retribution] into her hand. The essence of the hottest fire in the world. The instant that sharply honed blade of flame shot toward my heart.
“Jophiel!”
Tremendous sparks flew from my fingertips, and circular restraints reminiscent of halos bound Uriel's entire body. Just as the shocked Uriel cried out, the pure white restraints tightened around her.
Bzzzzzzzt!
Uriel's ‘Status’ diminished in an instant, and the flames blanketing the surroundings rapidly died down.
Uriel was one of the strongest archangels even within <Eden>. When it came to exterminating demons, no other angel could match her Status.
But what if her opponent was another archangel?
The archangel Jophiel.
Unlike the other angels, whose calling was to exterminate demons, Jophiel possessed one additional, special ability.
[Confinement of Good and Evil]
Jophiel's stigma, used to hunt fallen angels, was exerting its power against Uriel.
Crrrraaack!

The more Uriel tried to release her Status, the more tightly the restraints constricted her. After straining and grunting as she unleashed her power, Uriel finally stopped resisting and collapsed. An archangel caught in these restraints would fall into a deep sleep for a week.

I lifted the sleeping Uriel into my arms and walked out of the flames with Yoo Joonghyuk. Beyond the thick smoke, the companions were watching us. Some stared in shock, others in admiration…… and someone else was glaring at me with faint hostility in their eyes.
I looked at Han Sooyoung and said,
“This wasn't part of the world you envisioned, was it?”
“……Whether Uriel dies here or not doesn't affect the big picture. You saw it too, so you know, don't you? My plan is perfect.”
Her white coat fluttering, Han Sooyoung strode toward me.
She came right up to me and looked up into my face. Taking in the burned angel wings and the crumpled demon king horns, she asked,
“Kim Dokja, what kind of world do you wish for? You read that story to the very end. Surely there's a world you wish for.”
What Han Sooyoung had just said was a line I knew very well.
「“What kind of world do you want?”」
It was the line Yoo Joonghyuk always used when recruiting a new companion.
I said to Han Sooyoung,
“I'm not going to be your damned companion.”
“To complete this story, I need you.”
Han Sooyoung glanced at Yoo Joonghyuk and continued.
“And don't you need a new story to be completed too?”
She spoke as though she knew why I had come to this world.
I studied the faces of the surviving companions, one by one.
Lee Hyunsung, Lee Jihye, Lee Seolhwa, Shin Yoosung, Kim Namwoon……
Until now, there had never been a round in which all of them survived this far.
But.
“What's new about this story?”
I was looking at Yoo Joonghyuk.
The one character this world had not chosen.
The character who had repeated thousands of rounds to save the world, only to have to die for that world this time.
In the end, Han Sooyoung's world was also just a world where someone had to die.
And there were countless worlds like that besides Han Sooyoung's.
“All you did was take the original, change the order of events, and write someone else's name in the protagonist's place.”
Some copies might surpass the original.
But they could never become the original work (原作).
“Do you know what that kind of thing is called?”
I considered giving her a relaxed smile, but I wasn't in the mood for it either.
Han Sooyoung stared at me with blazing eyes and said,
“This isn't the ‘round’ you came from. Don't mouth off.”
Refusing to listen to any more, Han Sooyoung turned away.
“I'll give you three days. You'd better decide by then. Whether you'll help me or not. That's all I want to hear.”

Following Han Sooyoung, the companions went into the building one by one. Lee Seolhwa moved the injured, with Lee Hyunsung helping her. I saw Lee Jihye and Kim Namwoon glance my way as they walked off.
This was not my round.
The people in my round would be waiting for me, and I could only return to my round by killing this world's Yoo Joonghyuk.
I turned to Yoo Joonghyuk. He stood there with holes riddling his coat, his eyes still dull and vacant.
……But was that really the only way?
When Han Sooyoung opened her eyes in the darkness, she was in a cold sweat. Faint sparks crackled around her body. She felt cold enough to freeze.
Tzzzzzz…….
Han Sooyoung caught her breath and got up. She hurriedly switched on her smartphone and opened the file of her novel. SSSSS-grade Infinite Regressor.
「Yoo Joonhyun thought.」
「……I'm scared.」
「Can't I just stop here?」
Of all pages, the one she'd saved had to contain a passage like that. Even so, Han Sooyoung doggedly read it. She read it again and again, as if every word would vanish if she didn't.
Tzz, tzt…….

How long had she been reading like that? Little by little, the sparks around her began to subside. At last, she managed a sigh. Had she been even a little later, her very existence would have been swallowed up by the sparks.
This wasn't the first time.
The backlash of probability, gnawing away at all her memories. She couldn't tell whether it was a side effect of overusing [Avatar], or whether it had something to do with ‘Ways of Survival.’
[The ‘Star Stream’ is watching the incarnation ‘Han Sooyoung.’]
Biting her lip, Han Sooyoung slowly stretched. She checked her shoulders and wrists, stiff from the side effects, one joint at a time. She could feel countless constellations spying on her.
Han Sooyoung thought: Watch all you like. I didn't start this just to end here.
After she had stretched for a while, the cold that made her bones ache eased considerably. Han Sooyoung put on her coat and looked out the window.
She could see Kim Dokja and the companions.

They'd been awkward around each other on the first day, yet in just a few days they were on speaking terms. It was strange. People filled with distrust after ninety-four scenarios had opened up so quickly to that guy, of all people.
Kim Dokja.
The variable that had appeared at the final stage of this plan.
……Why had ‘Secretive Plotter’ sent someone else bound by a pledge at this point?
Han Sooyoung didn't know the answer.
All she knew for certain was that she had to make use of this Kim Dokja.
Yoo Joonghyuk stood in a corner of the square, his face expressionless.
After watching him for a moment, Han Sooyoung jumped out the window.
Landing lightly beside Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung spoke.
“Two days to go now.”
Yoo Joonghyuk gave no answer.
Han Sooyoung slowly turned toward him.
Empty eyes, as if he couldn't hear a thing.
Looking into those eyes, Han Sooyoung strode up to Yoo Joonghyuk.
“……Are you really unconscious?”
Han Sooyoung's hand shot out and caught Yoo Joonghyuk by the chin.
Yoo Joonghyuk showed no reaction.
“Funny. To end up like this now, of all times…… You haven't forgotten your promise to die for me, have you?”
Up close, the scars on Yoo Joonghyuk's face stood out.
The marks of a lonelier fight than in any round before.
Han Sooyoung studied him in silence.
A gaze that seemed almost pitying, almost angry.
Releasing Yoo Joonghyuk's chin, Han Sooyoung took a cigarette from inside her coat.
A hissing spark, followed by a curl of acrid smoke.
In the distance, she could see the companions surrounding Kim Dokja, shouting one thing or another.
Han Sooyoung blew out a puff of cigarette smoke and spoke.
“The world really is unfair. One person gets close to them so easily after just a few words, while another stays on the fringes even after all those regressions.”
“Why didn't you put those memories you gave me to good use? You could've managed it just fine, too…… No, forget it. There's no way you could.”
Han Sooyoung ground the fallen cigarette ash underfoot.
“I'll kill you even if you don't remember, so don't blame me. I did everything you asked.”
With those last words, Han Sooyoung walked toward the companions.
Yoo Joonghyuk watched her retreat with empty eyes.
Little by little, a faint light was returning to Yoo Joonghyuk's empty eyes.
I'd now spent two days at Han Sooyoung's headquarters.
During that time, I'd had several things to puzzle over.
First, to find out exactly what Han Sooyoung meant by ‘Yoo Joonghyuk's death.’
Second, to find out what Han Sooyoung ultimately hoped to gain from it.
Neither piece of information was easy to uncover.
……And those weren't my only headaches.
[It really was destroyed? Our <Eden>?]
I looked at Gabriel, who was radiating menace, and asked in return.
“It was. Didn't Metatron in the third round give you any hint?”
[……Are you saying the scribe knew about <Eden>'s destruction?]
I nodded.
“Ask him yourself when you get back. Provided you make it back safely, of course.”
At that, Gabriel's and Jophiel's stems began to tremble. I thought they were about to get angry with me, but they seemed to be talking to each other.
I took Uriel's doll out from inside my clothes. The restrictions [Confinement of Good and Evil] had placed on Uriel's incarnation body would keep her from using her powers for another five days.
「‘Fourth Wall’ looks into you.」

Perhaps I could borrow the power of ‘Fourth Wall’ to pass on my memories of the third round. ……But if I thought Uriel would be moved by those memories and take my side, I'd be imagining the sort of thing that only happened in fantasy.
After watching all those memories, Uriel would probably say this.
「■■, so what am I supposed to do about it?」
To Uriel, who had lived through the horrors of the 1863rd round, my memories of the third round would sound like nothing more than a story in a novel.
“Kim Dokja-ssi, you said you'd come hunting with us, didn't you?”
I looked up to find Lee Hyunsung standing there, wearing steel gauntlets.
“Is it all right for me to come along?”
“Yes, well…… Friend-or-foe identification doesn't mean much with a bullet you've picked up.”
Lee Hyunsung gave a sheepish smile as he said this. Whether it was the third round or the 1863rd, those strange metaphors never changed.
In my head, I tried to work out how many times Lee Hyunsung might have been sent to military jail by now.
[Your understanding of the character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ has increased.]
[The character ‘Lee Hyunsung’ shows slight goodwill toward you.]
This reminded me of the first scenario, leaving me with mixed feelings.
To ease Lee Hyunsung's wariness, I added an offhand remark.
“Aren't you being a little too trusting? I'm Yoo Joonghyuk's companion, you know.”

“Well…… Our leader hasn't said anything in particular, and…… how should I put it? I have a feeling you're not such a bad person, Dokja-ssi. Call it an instinct I've developed over ninety-four scenarios.”
Throughout the original novel, that instinct of Lee Hyunsung's was wrong most of the time.
Every time Lee Hyunsung said something like that, I'd think Yoo Joonghyuk was about to get stabbed in the back and fucking die.
“Hey, you're here? Let's see what you've got.”
The others joining the hunt were Kim Namwoon and Lee Jihye. With a large gray hood pulled over her head, Lee Jihye cast me a disapproving glance.
“Hurry up. We're leaving.”
I followed the group out of headquarters.
The purpose of this hunt was to clear out the ‘Nameless Ones’ remaining around headquarters and collect items.
That was the official reason, of course. I knew why Han Sooyoung had ordered this hunt.
―Two approaching from the front. One tentacle type and one composite type.
As Han Donghoon's message sounded out of thin air, Lee Jihye drew her sword.
[Instant Kill] activated, severing every tentacle. Kim Namwoon charged in right after her and activated [Black Flame], burning the tentacle type's main body.
I'd noticed it while reading the original, too: those two worked remarkably well together. As the monster burned away with a terrible scream, Kim Namwoon approached Lee Jihye with a smirk.
“Nice attack.”

Trying to look cool, Kim Namwoon raised his right hand toward Lee Jihye. With an icy look, Lee Jihye thrust her sword at him. The wind from her blade grazed Kim Namwoon's cheek and pierced the main body of the ‘Nameless One,’ which was regenerating its tentacles inside the [Black Flame].
Lee Jihye moved toward her next prey. Kim Namwoon followed her.
“Hey, wait for me!”
Would Gilyoung and Yoosung become a duo like that if they grew up?
If I went back, I might get to see something like that.
“Dokja-ssi?”
“Ah, yes. I'll handle that side.”

I hurriedly drew ‘Unbreakable Faith’ and activated [Way of the Wind]. Tentacles whistled toward me, exploiting the gaps in my defense. Since I was deliberately avoiding using [Electrification], dealing with the ‘Nameless Ones’ was a little tricky.
“Heh heh, you're weak, aren't you?”
With [Black Flame] clenched in both hands, Kim Namwoon began pummeling the ‘Nameless Ones,’ an unsettling smile on his face.
“Watch and learn!”
His combat prowess was certainly impressive. The way Kim Namwoon was now, he might be able to draw on about half the power of the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.’
I quietly cheered Kim Namwoon on.
“Nice work. Here comes another.”
“Hahaha, leave it to me!”
Kwoooooom!
“Wow. Still, that one over there would be too much for you, wouldn't it?”
“What are you talking about! Hahahaha! Die!”
“Whoa, then that one over there, too…….”
Kim Namwoon's eyebrows twitched as he belatedly caught on.

Beside me, the corners of Lee Hyunsung's mouth were twitching. Farther away, Lee Jihye clicked her tongue in disdain as she fought a monster. Just as Kim Namwoon raised a fist at me, his face contorting, I told him.
“Lee Jihye doesn't like show-offs.”
Kim Namwoon's face turned as white as his hair. His pupils were shaking as though an earthquake had struck.
But the real spectacle was Lee Hyunsung, standing wide-eyed beside us.
……This guy was just as clueless in every round.
His eyes darting between me and Lee Jihye in the distance, Kim Namwoon stammered.
“How do you know that?”

“It'd be strange not to know. Start by dyeing your hair and taking off those bandages. If you're going to wear fingerless gloves, at least wear them on both hands. And don't say things like ‘Nice attack’ after a hunt.”
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ dislikes you.]
“You'd have better luck acting like that guy back there.”
His face now bright red, Kim Namwoon looked at the man behind me.
Yoo Joonghyuk stood there with a vacant expression.
His coat was filthy and he hadn't even washed, but even that couldn't hide how handsome he was.
“That guy is ‘evil.’ Though he is cool.”
So said Kim Namwoon, the ‘Delusion Demon.’ I gave a small laugh and replied.
“Don't make him out to be such a bad guy. He has his good points.”
“Ha, figures you'd stick up for someone on your side. Come to think of it, how did you end up hanging around with Yoo Joonghyuk?”
As Kim Namwoon eyed me suspiciously, Lee Hyunsung spoke.
“I heard that you came from another worldline, Dokja-ssi.”
It seemed Han Sooyoung had told them about me.
Startled, Kim Namwoon pointed at me and asked.
“Another worldliiine? That's…… a parallel universe……?”
“Something like that.”
I was impressed that Kim Namwoon, who didn't even know basic biology, knew about parallel universes.
This round certainly differed in some ways from the one I remembered.
“Oh, so that's why we never saw you before. So? What brought you here?”
“You're excited, huh. Unfortunately, I can't tell you.”
“Tch. Then what am I doing in that world? Am I the leader, maybe?”
“You're dead.”
The color drained from Kim Namwoon's face again.
“I'm kidding. You're building Gunpla over there. You seemed really happy.”
“Gunpla? Ooh…….”
Lee Jihye had come over at some point, and she smacked Kim Namwoon on the back of the head.
“What are you grinning about? Pick up the items.”
“Uh, yeah.”
Watching Kim Namwoon hurry after Lee Jihye to collect the items, I thought.
Perhaps I shouldn't have killed him in the first scenario.
As Kim Namwoon trailed after Lee Jihye collecting items, he stole a few wary glances around, then whispered to me.
“Hey. I've got a favor to ask.”
“What?”
“Could you lend me your coat later, just for a bit?”
……So that was what he wanted.
“Depends on how you behave.”
Grumbling, Kim Namwoon went back to collecting items.
Lee Jihye nagging, and Lee Hyunsung laughing heartily.
It was a peaceful scene.
Yet amid that peace, I was only reminded all the more strongly that this wasn't my world.
No Jung Heewon here.
No Lee Gilyoung, either.
……Right, no Han Myungoh either.
So I had to go back, no matter what.
Before long, we had collected all the items in the area.
As I examined the items we'd collected, I smiled.
It was here, just as I'd thought.
To clear Scenario 95, we needed the ‘five renowned swords’ that served as keys. Han Sooyoung probably knew that one of those swords was somewhere nearby.
But the moment I drew the sword, I gave a start.
“Um, Hyunsung-ssi.”
“Yes?”
“Did Han Sooyoung tell you to retrieve this sword?”
Looking over the sword, Lee Hyunsung answered my question.
“Ah, yes. This is the sword we were looking for.”
Scenario 95 was a scenario in which the ‘five renowned swords’ served as keys.
A scenario where those five swords were used as keys to release the sealed ‘Apocalypse Dragon.’
But this sword…….
A chilling premonition flashed through my mind.
When I looked up at the sky, the enormous [Sealing Sphere of the Apocalypse Dragon] gazed haughtily down at us.
The greatest and most terrible dragon of destruction (破滅龍) in ‘Ways of Survival,’ asleep within the pitch-black sphere.
In the original story, Yoo Joonghyuk was supposed to release that dragon, obtain the Giant Story ‘Liberator of the Apocalypse Dragon,’ and advance to the final scenario.
「At that moment, Kim Dokja realized how to kill Yoo Joonghyuk.」
The sword hilt trembled in my tight grip.
「And that Han Sooyoung was thinking exactly the same thing he was.」
All that day, Kim Dokja read and reread ‘Ways of Survival.’

He read and reread pages he had already read, checking whether there was anything between the lines that he had missed. Kim Dokja seemed to be looking for something. Or perhaps failing to find it. As he stared down at his smartphone, he repeatedly clutched his head and sighed.
“……You're too loud. Stop talking.”
And sometimes he cursed at [Fourth Wall], too. In any case, Kim Dokja was trying. It was an effort to change something, an effort that perhaps no one would ever recognize.
Before long, a glimmer of resolve appeared in Kim Dokja's eyes.

It wasn't a resolve built up in a day or two. It was a resolve only someone who had read a single story for a long time without missing a word could have. With that resolve, Kim Dokja continued reading ‘Ways of Survival.’ Reading, reading, and reading again.
How much longer did he read like that? Kim Dokja's eyes, which had shone like stars, slowly dimmed. Kim Dokja drifted into a light sleep.
Yoo Joonghyuk watched the scene with empty eyes.
Kim Dokja's weary back.
The steady sound of snoring.
Tzzzt, tzt.
With a tiny spark, the light was returning to Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes. A fierce murderous intent filled his once-empty gaze, and it was directed at precisely one person.
Shiiing.
With a quiet ring, Yoo Joonghyuk drew [Splitting the Sky Sword] from his back. He approached Kim Dokja on silent feet and leveled the sword at Kim Dokja's throat.
Tzzzt.
「Ha ha, that would be a prob lem」
Yoo Joonghyuk frowned. [Fourth Wall] was crackling with restless sparks, as if it would wake Kim Dokja at any moment. Yoo Joonghyuk sent a message to the illusory ‘wall’ through [Sound Transmission].
―Don't even think about waking him. If you do, I'll take his head off immediately.
「H mm」
The sparks produced by [Fourth Wall] rapidly diminished in intensity.
Yoo Joonghyuk did not draw back his sword. [Fourth Wall] faced him, spewing letters into the air.
「What do you wa nt?」
Yoo Joonghyuk said nothing.
He seemed to be searching for the words, or perhaps he didn't know what those words were.
Then [Fourth Wall] let out a strange laugh.
「A ha, I under stand」
「You're curi ous, aren't you ?」
Yoo Joonghyuk still didn't answer, but [Fourth Wall] kept laughing as though it already knew everything.
The letters of [Fourth Wall] began to multiply.

The letters embroidering the air in gold soon filled the room. Yoo Joonghyuk watched the letters drifting around him for a moment, then reached out toward one. As if responding to his hand, the letters began to tell a story.
「“I'm Dokja.”」
「I really do introduce myself to people this way, and it often leads to the following misunderstanding.」
A story of a world he had never experienced.
[Fourth Wall] giggled.
「This will be ve ry enter taining」
Yoo Joonghyuk quietly listened to the story.
Until the night deepened, and then the deep night waned and a faint dawn crept in.
When Kim Dokja finally woke, Yoo Joonghyuk stood leaning against the wall with empty eyes, as if nothing had happened.
“……I fell asleep, damn it.”
Kim Dokja ruffled his hair, staggered to his feet, and picked up his smartphone and sword.
Looking out the window, he saw the headquarters' troops already lined up.
The companions who had gathered to clear Scenario 95.
He saw Han Sooyoung in her white coat, looking up at him from the center of the group.
Today was the day the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ would die.
